item.description: Electrek — Foxconn is buying half of Mitsubishi Electric’s auto parts business for ¥115 billion ($727 million), its biggest bet yet on turning years of EV promises into a real car business. But the target, Mitsubishi Electric Mobility, isn’t an EV company. It’s a traditional Tier 1 supplier that makes everything from alternators and ignition coils to radar sensors, with a smaller electric powertrain...

item.title: Longi researchers reveal how edge masking reduces recombination losses in solar cells
item.description: PV Magazine — Longi researchers found that edge masking improves the measured efficiency of heterojunction back-contact solar cells by suppressing edge recombination, with an optimal masking width of 5 mm. Their simulations suggest that selective metallization could further increase efficiency from 26.85% to a theoretical maximum of 27.39%.

item.title: JinkoSolar unveils 28%-efficient back-contact TOPCon solar cell with amorphous silicon heterojunction passivation
item.description: PV Magazine — JinkoSolar has unveiled its first back-contact solar cell technology, combining TOPCon and heterojunction passivation in a new architecture called TAC. The Chinese manufacturer reported a peak cell conversion efficiency of 28%.

item.title: Sri Lanka asks PV system owners to disconnect after nationwide blackout
item.description: PV Magazine — Sri Lanka has ordered PV system owners to disconnect from the grid following a nationwide blackout on Oct. 17. The outage follows a similar incident in February 2025, when high solar penetration was identified as a major contributing factor.
